text: v1.0.139 is out. It has: (1) grading asks ESPN/PropLine for games the first score feed lacks (for the 24 stuck both-sides bets), (2) the Tracker's all-time profit headline is now the wallet figure (cash + open at cost - net put in), the bets' sum only as detail. Link: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.139 . Next: the parlay maker. Note the wallet says about -$252, so the $300 gap vs the bets list is what I'm chasing (parlay results/fees).
